an4.170:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an4.170:1.3: Tatra kho āyasmā Ānando bhikkhū āmantesi:
an4.170:1.5: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an4.170:2.1: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattapattiṃ vyākaroti sabbo so catuhi aṅgehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an4.170:3.2: Idha āvuso bhikkhū samathapubbaṅgamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāveti,
an4.170:3.3: tassa samathapubbaṅgamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
an4.170:3.4: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
an4.170:3.5: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā vyantihonti. 3.
an4.170:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāveti,
an4.170:4.2: tassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
an4.170:4.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti, bahulīkaroti.
an4.170:4.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā vyantihonti. 4.
an4.170:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti,
an4.170:5.2: tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
an4.170:5.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato . . . bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti anusayā vyantihonti. 5.
an4.170:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno dhammuddhaccaviggahītamanā
an4.170:6.2: hoti, so āvuso samayo yan taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ yeva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodihoti samādhīyati,
an4.170:7.1: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike arahattapattiṃ vyākaroti sabbo so imehi catuhi aṅgehi etesaṃ vā aññatarenāti. [Tass' uddānaṃ:--
